This listing marks one of the largest restaurant IPOs in recent years. The company operates over three thousand three hundred locations across the United States and Canada. Jersey Mike's offering tests investor confidence in the wider retail sector.

title: Mastercard profit beats estimates on strong consumer spending
description: Mastercard reported better-than-expected second-quarter profits on Thursday.  Strong transaction volumes and resilient consumer spending supported the company's financial performance.  Gross dollar volume rose eight percent, and net revenue increased fourteen percent.

title: NSE Q1 Results: Profit rises 7% YoY to Rs 3,120 crore; revenue up 9%
description: National Stock Exchange reported a seven percent profit rise for the June quarter. Higher transaction charges and strong operating margins contributed to this financial growth. Consolidated total income also saw a nine percent increase year-on-year. The exchange is currently preparing for its proposed initial public offering. NSE's contribution to the exchequer reached over twenty thousand crore rupees.

title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Friday
description: Indian equities extended gains after the US Federal Reserve kept rates unchanged, with Sensex rising 274 points and Nifty closing above 24,300. Strong FII inflows and upbeat earnings supported sentiment, though hawkish Fed commentary, rising bond yields and weak broader markets capped gains.

title: Qualcomm shares fall 5% as higher costs, Apple-related weakness cloud profit forecast
description: Qualcomm's stock has seen a notable drop following its alert about escalating memory costs. Increased expenditures and rising prices are expected to strain profit margins in the immediate future. The firm has projected an adjusted earnings per share that falls short of analysts' estimates. Additionally, Qualcomm's share in the modem supply for the upcoming iPhone will significantly decrease.

title: NYSE parent ICE to buy MarketAxess in $5.7 billion deal to expand fixed-income offerings
description: Intercontinental Exchange has made a significant move by agreeing to acquire the bond trading platform MarketAxess for a hefty $5.7 billion, reflecting a 33% premium over its latest closing price. This acquisition is poised to bolster ICE's fixed-income trading offerings, resulting in a notable 30% jump in MarketAxess shares after the announcement. The deal is anticipated to finalize in the first half of 2027.

title: Fusion Klassroom raises over Rs 11 crore from anchor investors; SME IPO to open on Friday
description: Fusion Klassroom Edutech has successfully secured Rs 11.08 crore from key anchor investors. The company is set to launch its initial public offering on July 31st, with the IPO valued at Rs 39.04 crore, which will remain open until August 4th. Following the offering, shares are expected to be listed on the BSE SME platform on August 7th.

title: Rs 104 lakh crore club: India's richest 3,040 now hold wealth equal to 30% of GDP
description: India’s 3,040 richest individuals hold Rs 104 lakh crore in wealth, nearly 30% of nominal GDP, highlighting growing wealth concentration. The latest report also shows rising participation from young entrepreneurs, women and first-generation founders alongside established business families.

title: Microsoft shares surge 16% as AI cloud bet starts showing up in numbers
description: Microsoft shares surged 16% after stronger-than-expected guidance, robust Azure cloud growth and rising Microsoft 365 Copilot adoption eased concerns over AI spending. The company also forecast healthy cash generation, reinforcing investor confidence in its long-term artificial intelligence strategy and cloud leadership.

title: Tata Steel Q1 Results: Profit rises 15% to Rs 2,318 crore, revenue climbs 14%
description: Tata Steel reported a 15% year-on-year rise in Q1 consolidated net profit to Rs 2,318 crore, driven by higher revenue and stronger operating performance. Revenue grew 14%, while profit before tax increased despite higher expenses and exceptional restructuring-related charges during the quarter.
